* Build strictly lagged predictors without using held-out outcomes or statistics computed from future games/seasons.
* Freeze an untouched chronological holdout; use only earlier data for feature selection, scaling and model/hyperparameter choice.
* Compare an eligible baseline and forecast model on the same untouched observations; report error and calibration with sample counts and limitations.
* Add leakage/availability tests proving that changing future observations cannot change earlier prediction inputs or training-fitted transformations.
* Document the evaluation protocol and source/data version so the results can be reproduced.

Mitigation Strategy.value:
1. Save the pause and free-project-limit notices as evidence. Download the available database backup and storage objects and keep them securely before changing project arrangements.
2. Review active free projects with Abdul and the relevant project owners. With the owner's approval, pause an unused, non-critical project to free capacity. Do not pause another required service or delete the capstone project.
3. If no suitable project can be paused, agree an affordable paid-plan option with the team before upgrading. Do not make unapproved billing changes.
4. After freeing capacity or arranging an approved upgrade, resume "Basketball Playtype Ranker". Verify the dashboard status and test the application's implemented Supabase-dependent functions, including login and profile/role access where used.
5. Record the action taken and actual test results in Jira. If resuming is still blocked, contact Supabase support and notify Abdul and the supervisor when a deadline is at risk.
6. Review within 48 hours, then daily while blocked. After successful resumption and application checks, move to Monitoring and reassess probability. Review availability and free-project capacity weekly and before demonstrations. Track the dashboard's 01 Jun 2027 resumption deadline.
